input.reflection: Conclusion: single root fault is the seat->config connection. ts-seat-service GET calls to ts-config-service (per left_tickets request) hang ~130s and fail with 'Connection timed out'; config never receives those lookups (GET /configs/{configName} 598 normal -> 0 abnormal), config pod has no restart, no CPU/memory saturation, no hubble data. Kind: network_partition (equivalent to network_loss).
